title: Receipt, Application and Completion of Property Charge Advance Repayment Payments
content:
Repayments toward a Property Charge Advance Repayment arrearage are accepted by any of the product's accepted payment methods without penalty, the prepayment penalty rate being nil, and are applied to the oldest advance first, as the product's application order provides; each repayment reduces the loan balance as a prepayment. Each payment is recorded once, identified by its payment reference. A payment smaller than the installment is applied but the installment still counts as missed if not completed by the end of its grace period; a larger payment reduces the arrearage and shortens the final installments. The record is completed on the day the arrearage balance reaches 0.00, whether in the notice period or during an arrangement, and a completion letter follows within the product's completion-letter period in calendar days. Each repayment is identified by its payment confirmation number; where autopay is available, installments may be drafted by ACH on the product's autopay draft day, and a reminder goes out the product's reminder period in calendar days before each due day.

## Recording a payment once

A payment is recorded against the arrangement only once. Its payment reference is the identity of the payment: a payment reference already recorded as a repayment is not recorded a second time. Whether the reference is already on record is read from the repayments in the system's records before the payment is recorded.

## Effect of a payment by its size

| Payment compared with the installment due | Effect |
|---|---|
| Smaller | Applied; the installment still counts as missed if it is not completed by the end of its grace period |
| Larger | Reduces the arrearage and shortens the final installments |
| Any repayment | Applied to the oldest advance first, and reduces the loan balance as a prepayment |

## Completion

| Arrearage balance after the payment | Record |
|---|---|
| 0.00, while the record is in its notice period | Completed on that day |
| 0.00, during an arrangement | Completed on that day |
| Above 0.00 | Not completed by that payment |

A completion letter follows each completion within the completion-letter period.

### Hypothetical illustration

A hypothetical Repayment Plan - 12 Months arrangement has an installment of 150.00 and an arrearage of 450.00. A payment of 60.00 is applied, but if the remaining 90.00 of that installment is not paid by the end of its grace period, the installment counts as missed. A later payment of 390.00 by money order brings the arrearage to 0.00, and the record is completed on the day it is received. The figures are illustrative only.
